prompt_text: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset bg_rua_near for a 2D side-view fighting game. Output one PNG 1536x512. Input image 1 is the mandatory STYLE REFERENCE, not the composition to reproduce: match its high-resolution cel-shaded anime illustration, thick dark outline #15101C, two-tone flat shading, crisp restrained rim light and retrofuturist city palette. Orthographic strict side/front view, sunset light from the left; no perspective convergence. Subject: foreground street furniture strip: street lamps, trees in planters, metal railings, a banner pole; darker, bottom-aligned. Fully transparent background with real alpha; if impossible use flat pure magenta #FF00FF, no gradient, no shadow.No characters, HUD, readable text, watermarks, ground planes, cast drop shadows or unrelated props. Draw only the requested layer/components, ready for combination with separately generated assets.
